We’ve Got Answers FAQs Who should attend UK Biotech Day? UK Biotech Day is a flagship gathering of the complete life sciences ecosystem, bringing together decision-makers and industry leaders under one roof. The event is designed for: • Biotech & Pharma companies • Investors, VCs & private equity • Life sciences industry service providers • Academia & research institutions • Startups & scale-ups • Government organizations • Technology & Digital Health companies • Regulatory, policy & ecosystem enablers • Diagnostics & MedTech companies With representation across the full life science value chain, UK Biotech Day is a must-attend platform to exchange insights, build strategic networks, identify assets and partnering opportunities, foster collaboration and shape the future of the industry. How many participants are expected to attend UK Biotech Day? UK Biotech Day is expected to welcome 700+ participants from across the global life sciences ecosystem, including senior decision-makers, industry leaders and key stakeholders. The event is designed to enable high level networking, meaningful discussions and strategic collaborations in a highly curated, business focused environment. Is there a partnering platform available? Yes. UK Biotech Day offers a dedicated partnering platform designed to facilitate one-to-one pre-arranged meetings. The platform enables participants to connect with key partners, schedule meetings in advance and maximise networking and partnering opportunities before and during the event. What is the expected seniority level of attendees? UK Biotech Day is an exclusive, high level event representing the full spectrum of leadership across the life sciences ecosystem. Participants typically include C-Level executives (CEOs, Founders, Co-founders, Presidents), Senior Management (VPs, Heads, Directors of Business Development, R&D, Clinical, Supply Chain & Manufacturing, Scientific, Digital Health, Regulatory and Commercial functions), as well as Mid-Level Management, providing a high level audience for strategic discussions, networking and partnership opportunities. What makes UK Biotech Day unique? UK Biotech Day is where the life sciences world comes alive. Our dedicated partnering platform enables participants to schedule one-to-one pre-arranged meetings in advance, ensuring you connect with the right people. With multi-stream sessions, a high impact exhibition and curated senior-level attendees, UK Biotech Day provides a highly focused, results-driven environment for building partnerships, exploring opportunities and shaping the future of the industry.
